entries.t: Microsoft: China’s Salt Typhoon hackers are using Artex
entries.sum: An AI tool implicated in several high-profile breaches is rapidly being integrated into the hacking suites of groups from China and North Korea, Microsoft said.

entries.how: Through a third party or supplier.

entries.t: UK’s long-awaited National Cyber Action Plan delayed until December
entries.sum: Officials, who had planned to publish the document in mid-November, now aim to unveil the strategy for defending the wider economy against state-backed and criminal hackers on December 9.

entries.t: Cyprus Becomes Espionage Target for Iranian Hackers
entries.sum: A previously undocumented Iranian threat group called "Volant Manticore" is targeting Cypriot organizations as part of an intelligence-gathering effort for Tehran.

entries.t: 1Password Breach Exposes Customer Data, Internal Source Code
entries.sum: A hacker used a compromised employee GitHub account to push malicious code and steal customer records, but vaults were not accessed.

entries.t: Drupal Installer Patch Left a Gap Attackers Are Already Exploiting
entries.sum: Drupal warns that its previous installer patch left some websites vulnerable to takeover, with attackers already exploiting the gap.

entries.t: Data recovery firm co-founder accused of cashing in on ransomware victims
